duels.title: Duels
duels.subtitle: Head-to-head battles with curated competitive programming presets.
duels.queueHeroDescription: Open a duel call, let someone claim it, then lock in the start time together.
duels.queueSubtitle: Open duel calls waiting for someone to propose a start time.
duels.needsResponseSubtitle: Calls where the next move belongs to you.
duels.myCallsSubtitle: Everything you created, claimed or negotiated.
duels.historySubtitle: Your confirmed duels and recent public duel history.
duels.recentDuelsDescription: Fresh public duel history across the platform.
duels.noQueueCalls: No open duel calls right now.
duels.noNeedsResponseCalls: You have no calls waiting for your response.
duels.noMyCalls: You have no duel calls yet.
duels.signInDescription: Create calls, challenge bots and negotiate a start time from your account.
duels.createCallDescription: Pick a preset and scoring type. The opponent will propose the start time after claiming your call.
duels.howItWorksCreate: Create an open call with a preset and duel type. Multiple open calls can wait in parallel.
duels.howItWorksSchedule: Another player claims your call and proposes a start time. You can confirm it or send a counter-offer.
duels.howItWorksLock: When one duel becomes fully confirmed, the rest of both players' open negotiations are cancelled automatically.
duels.acceptCallDescription: Choose a start time to claim {{username}}'s duel call.
duels.suggestNewTimeDescription: Choose a new start time for {{username}}.
duels.ratingSubtitle: Track top duelists and their records.
duels.problemsHiddenUntilStart: Problems unlock when the duel starts.
duels.editorUnlockedOnStart: Editor unlocks when the duel starts.
duels.signInForAttempts: Sign in to view your attempts.
